items.text: watercolor (Pro; Water › Surface › watercolor): drops of colored ink fall into the clear water as it fills, from a third full, and swirl in it (swirl), or ink and clear water fall in turn at one spot and the ink spreads in rings, as on a suminagashi bath (rings); a tap drops your own; the ink stays where the water dries; clear ink, or dry again, gives clear water
the light can keep the ground (Light › the ground: kept; also on the light's ring): the light falls on the particles and the water, the ground keeps its own colour
pattern walls (Pro; Water › Surface › walls): the pattern's lines hold the water still, so waves meet them and come back and pass only through the gaps; scenes can carry it

drain the water (Water › Surface › drain): evaporate (the level sinks over the bars, the shallows first, the hollows last, the beads shrink away), tip (the floor tips to one side and the water runs off), fall (gravity takes over: the water line drops from the top, faster and faster, a ragged front throwing spray, the drops left behind staying); fill again brings it back
the rain that fills the pool is capped at 160 drops a second

Current v0.91 is timed on Fibonacci numbers: 8, 5, 5, 13, 5, 8, 8, 5, 3, 5, 13 bars (5:12); the whales at the golden section, the quake a short shock; a copy you have not changed takes it when you play the show, one you dressed keeps yours and shows the refresh dot
the splash droplets show again as the water fills: their little lenses catch the light

the water's tremble as it fills no longer shows a fine regular grid ("goosebumps") on loud beats: seven waves in different directions and lengths, never a repeating pattern, rising over a third of a second, never finer than 10 px
a sequence entry can stay 3, 5, 13 or 21 bars, for running orders timed on Fibonacci numbers
Light in the Color ring (a dot that opens the Light ring: on, the named lights, strength, mode, turn, breathe, editor) and in the top drawer (a Light swatch after Ground 2 that opens the same ring)
light that moves: turn its direction once a beat, a bar, or every 2 to 16 bars, or let the dice pick; breathe: its strength sinks and returns once a beat, a bar or two bars

a scene's light fades over its morph: colors, strength and direction ease into the next scene's light; a light going off fades out, one coming on rises; touching the light during a fade takes over at once
